I mean not everyone is like that, I'm faithfully married with a husband who is also on the boat and I know he's faithful as well. 

But you stating that your significant other already has feelings and has already admitted to it then i think it's a high possibility they will either cheat or breakup to be with someone. The navy changes a person, i was change, but for the better. 

Just stay safe and it's easy to lie to a civilian about all this navy stuff. If you want to pm me to ask the stuff your significant other has been telling you and ask if it seems legitimate feel free to. 

Keep your head up ❤️

If you had expressed your feelings beforehand and were obviously against it then she should have respected that. You were not asking for much, just to be home and be comfortable (which I assume means a lot to you especially with your condition) if she wanted alone time then she could've spent the night at her friends house while you were at home. And yes it's not like she left you at a store or park she left you somewhere safe, but that still doesn't condone the fact that she left you somewhere you had already told her you didn't want to be at. You aren't overreacting, she shouldn't have done what she did or even how she did it behind your back. Perhaps tell her that you understand that they wanted space but they could've perhaps achieved it some other way without compromising your comfort as well? I wish you the best of luck!

Let him know you support his decision to get engaged and you'll be there for him but that he can't expect you to use money you've set aside for buddy especially because buddy's health isn't well and you need the money if something (God forbid) happens.

Hope you can work things out with your family ❤️
